aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable as final evidence because it has no review case and only sparse before/after context.
issues: No generated review case to verify
No extracted metrics or measurable results
Changed factor is ambiguous: cut worker, line/fid position, or inspection duration
Outcome/decision evidence is missing or not cited
Likely image/embedded content not represented in extracted rows
requiredUserQuestions: What is the actual changed factor shown in the before/after sections?
What final decision or result should be cited from the report?
correctionPlan: Inspect workbook images and hidden/merged cells around before/after sections
Create one review case if a comparable before/after change is confirmed
Cite rows for title, purpose, before/after labels, and decision/result
Preserve separate contexts for part array and visual inspection if both support same change
Leave needs_review if result cannot be text-cited
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current row citations are insufficient for Ask AI final evidence; decision/result citations are required.
